title: Volvo Trucks North America: VOLVO HEAVY TRUCK/EATON/DRIVE AXLE HOUSINGS (42 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  CLASS 8 HEAVY DUTY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH EATON DRIVE AXLES AND AXILOK SPINDLE NUTS.  THE DRIVE AXLE HOUSINGS CONSIST OF A PLATE STEEL CENTER SECTION AND TWO FORGED SPINDLES, ONE OF WHICH IS WELDED TO EACH END OF THE CENTER SECTION.  EACH SPINDLE CONTAINS A KEYWAY SLOT IN WHICH THE LOCKING TAB FOR THE WHEEL BEARING NUT LOCKING MECHANISM IS INSERTED.  THE LENGTH OF THE KEYWAY SLOT MAY NOT BE LONG ENOUGH TO ACCOMMODATE THE TAB CAUSING THE TAB TO BE DEFORMED OR DAMAGED DURING INSTALLATION.

title: REXHALL INDUSTRIES INC: REXHALL INDUSTRIES/RV AWNINGS (100 affected)
summary: THE AWNINGS FOR THE SLIDE-OUT ROOM CAN UNFURL OR UNROLL DURING TRANSIT CAUSING THE BRACKET TO RIP FREE OF THE SIDEWALL OF THE VEHICLE.

title: HINO DIESEL TRUCKS(USA): HINO/UNIVERSAL JOINT ASSEMBLY (606 affected)
summary: THE PROPELLER SHAFT UNIVERSAL JOINTS ARE DAMAGED.

title: Lotus Cars Limited: LOTUS/FMVSS 208 (240 affected)
summary: AIR BAG AND SEAT BELT SYSTEM WARNING LABELS ARE MISSING FROM THE SUN VISOR.  THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 108, "OCCUPANT CRASH PROTECTION."

title: ELECTRONIC MOBILITY CONTROLS: ELECTRONIC MOBILITY/STEERING (133 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  AN ELECTRONIC DEVICE FOR USE BY PHYSICALLY CHALLENGED INDIVIDUALS TO STEER A MOTOR VEHICLE.  POSSIBLE UNWANTED MOTION AT THE FACTORY STEERING WHEEL CAN RESULT IN A MOMENTARY LOSS OF CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE STEERING.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/PARKING BRAKE SYSTEM (3,667 affected)
summary: THE PARKING BRAKE CYLINDER ROD CAN SEPARATE FROM THE SOCKET THAT IT IS THREADED INTO DUE TO DEFECTIVE THREADS.

title: General Motors, LLC: GENERAL MOTORS/WHEEL LUG NUTS (21,582 affected)
summary: THE WHEEL LUG NUTS WERE NOT TIGHTENED TO THE PROPER SPECIFICATION DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: NAVISTAR/OPTIMIZED IDLE SYSTEM (93 affected)
summary: THESE VEHICLES ARE EQUIPPED WITH A DETROIT DIESEL OPTIMIZED IDLE SYSTEM.  IF THE IGNITION IS TURNED ON AND THE FUSE FOR THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE (ECM) POWER FEED LINE IS REMOVED OR BURNED OUT, UNINTENTIONAL CRANKING OF THE ENGINE WILL OCCUR..

title: Land Rover: LAND ROVER/DOOR SYSTEM (20,889 affected)
summary: THE RIGHT FRONT DOOR CAN FAIL TO LATCH FULLY WHEN CLOSING, CAUSING THE DOOR TO "BOUNCE" BACK OFF THE DOOR SEALS.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: ISUZU/SEAT BELT BUCKLE (2,345 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITH AN INCORRECT REAR CENTER SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY BUCKLE.  THE MISBUILD INVOLVED FITTING A BUCKLE FOR ANOTHER MARKET WITH THE CORRECT U.S. SPECIFICATION SEAT BELT.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): HONDA/SEAT BELT BUCKLE (163 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES WERE MANUFACTURED WITH AN INCORRECT REAR CENTER SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY BUCKLE.  THE MISBUILD INVOLVED FITTING A BUCKLE FOR ANOTHER MARKET WITH THE CORRECT U.S. SPECIFICATION SEAT BELT.

title: Tiffin Motorhomes, Inc.: ALLEGRO/AUXILLIARY GENERATOR (63 affected)
summary: THE  "O" RINGS OF THE REGULATOR ASSEMBLY IN THE ONAN EMERALD AND MARQUIS BRAND GENERATOR SETS CAN WEAKEN AND BREAK WHEN EXPOSED TO HIGH AMBIENT TEMPERATURES.

title: General Motors, LLC: GENERAL MOTORS/STEERING COLUMN (424 affected)
summary: THE STEERING COLUMN LOWER PINCH BOLT WAS NOT PROPERLY TIGHTENED DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: General Motors, LLC: GENERAL MOTORS/FMVSS 108/4 WAY FLASHERS (270,014 affected)
summary: THE FRONT AND/OR REAR HAZARD WARNING LAMPS (FOUR-WAY FLASHERS) DO NOT FLASH WHEN THE HAZARD SWITCH IS ACTIVATED.  THIS FAILS TO COMPLY WITH FMVSS NO. 108, "LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES, AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT."

title: METROTRANS CORPORATION: METROTRANS/ISRINGHAUSEN/SEATS (87 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  BUSES EQUIPPED WITH ISRINGHAUSEN SEATS IN THE DRIVER POSITION.   TWO WELDS LOCATED ON THE BACK REST ADJUSTMENT SIDE OF THE SEAT FRAME DID NOT MEET THE MANUFACTURER'S SPECIFICATIONS.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/THROTTLE ICING (22,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLES ORIGINALLY SOLD OR CURRENTLY REGISTERED IN THE FOLLOWING STATES: ALASKA, MONTANA, NORTH DAKOTA, MINNESOTA, WISCONSIN, MICHIGAN (UPPER PENINSULA), NEW YORK, MAINE, VERMONT, AND NEW HAMPSHIRE.    OPERATION AT HIGHWAY SPEEDS DURING EXTREME COLD, NORTHERN CLIMATE WINTER CONDITIONS, CAN RESULT IN ICE FORMING IN THE THROTTLE BODY OF THE ENGINE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/REAR AXLE (25,000 affected)
summary: THE REAR AXLE TRACK BAR BRACKET CAN SEPARATE FROM THE FRAME DUE TO MISSING WELDS OR INADEQUATE WELD PENETRATION.

title: SUNBEAM CORPORATION: SUNBEAM/AUTO THROW (12,000 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION: AUTO THROW LAP BLANKETS MANUFACTURED BY SUNBEAM CORPORATION AND SOLD TO WAL-MART STORES AND THERM TECHNOLOGY CORPORATION.  DATE CODED I (1995) OR J (1996) PRODUCTION.  TWO CIRCUITS WERE CROSSED-WIRED ON THESE THROWS.

title: CHANCE COACH, INC.: CHANCE COACH/CNG ROOF TOP FUEL TANK LIDS (20 affected)
summary: THE FASTENERS SECURING THE COMPRESSED NATURAL GAS (CNG) ROOF-MOUNTED FUEL TANK LIDS WERE NOT PROPERLY INSTALLED AND/OR MAINTAINED.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: MACK/U-JOINT STRAP BOLTS (1,590 affected)
summary: THE U-JOINT BEARING STRAP BOLTS WERE NOT PROPERLY TIGHTENED DURING ASSEMBLY.

title: Ford Motor Company: FORD/SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE (133,000 affected)
summary: THE SEAT ELT ANCHORAGE ATTACHMENTS ARE MISSING OR MISINSTALLED ON THESE VEHICLES.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/TAIL LIGHT (41 affected)
summary: THE TAIL LIGHT USED ON THESE VEHICLES WAS NOT CERTIFIED FOR THE UNITED STATES.

title: FRUEHAUF CORPORATION: WINNEBAGO/LP TANK MOUNTING (57 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: MOTOR HOMES BUILT ON A CHEVROLET CHASSIS.  THE FRAME RAIL EXTENSION WILL NOT SUPPORT A FULL LIQUID PROPANE (LP) GAS TANK.  VIBRATION OF THE TANK CAN CAUSE THE MOUNTING HARDWARE TO BECOME LOOSE AND EVENTUALY COULD CAUSE THE TANK TO FALL OFF.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): CHRYSLER/ABS (52,000 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS).    THE ANTILOCK BRAKE SYSTEM (ABS) HYDRAULIC CONTROL UNIT CAN EXPERIENCE EXCESSIVE BRAKE ACTUATOR PISTON SEAL WEAR WHICH COULD CAUSE PUMP-MOTOR DETERIORATION.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: WINNEBAGO/AUXILLIARY GENERATOR (138 affected)
